title: प्रहरी सरुवा-बढुवाको ‘जाम’ खोल्न आतुर नयाँ आईजीपी, गृहमन्त्रीलाई पर्खिँदै
content:
No ads found for this position नवनियुक्त आईजीपी डा. मनोजकुमार केसीले संगठनका नियमित सरुवा बढुवाको अवरोध खोल्न गृहमन्त्री सुधन गुरुङको प्रतीक्षा गर्दैछन्। प्रहरीमा १३-१४ महिनादेखि कार्यरत अधिकृतहरूको सरुवा रोकिएका कारण अन्य अधिकृतहरू अवसरबाट विमुख हुँदैछन्। Newly appointed IGP Dr. Manoj Kumar KC is waiting for Home Minister Sudhan Gurung to remove the obstacles to regular transfers and promotions in the organization. As transfers of officers who have been working in the police for 13-14 months have been halted, other officers are being deprived of opportunities. काठमाडौं । प्रहरीका नवनियुक्त आईजीपी डा. मनोजकुमार केसी संगठनका नियमित सरुवा-बढुवाको अवरोध (जाम) खोल्न आतुर देखिएका छन् । त्यसका लागि हाल दुबई भ्रमणमा रहेका गृहमन्त्री सुधन गुरुङको प्रतीक्षामा रहेको उनले नेपाल प्रेसलाई बताएका छन् । नेपाल प्रेस सँगको भेटमा आईजीपी डा. केसीले संगठनले गर्नुपर्ने केही नियमित काम विभिन्न कारणले रोकिएको र गृहमन्त्री तथा मन्त्रालयसँग समन्वय गरेर छिट्टै ती काम सम्पन्न गर्ने बताएका हुन् । सामान्यतया एक वर्षको कार्य अवधिका लागि सरुवा भएर विभिन्न जिल्ला र इलाका प्रहरी कार्यालयका प्रमुखसहितका अधिकृत १३-१४ महिनादेखि त्यहीँ कार्यरत छन् । यसले कार्यालय प्रमुखसहित विभिन्न जिम्मेवारीको अवसर पर्खिएका अन्य अधिकृत सरुवाबाट विमुख हुँदै आएका छन् । तत्कालीन आईजीपी दानबहादुर कार्की प्रधानमन्त्रीको सुरक्षा सल्लाहकार नियुक्त भएपछि एक एआईजी पद रिक्त छ । तीन महिनादेखि २४ डीएसपीका दरबन्दी रिक्त छन् । २०६४ मा इन्स्पेक्टर भएका एक, २०७१ का चार र २०७२ मा इन्स्पेक्टर भर्ना भएका १९ अधिकृत उक्त बढुवाका दाबेदार हुन् । प्रहरी नेतृत्व र सरकारबीच केही समयदेखि समन्वय अभाव हुँदा महत्त्वपूर्ण मानिने सरुवा-बढुवाजस्ता काममा बाधा पुगेको थियो । तत्कालीन आईजीपी कार्कीलाई सरकारले सुरक्षा सल्लाहकार नियुक्त गर्दै डा. केसीलाई आईजीपी नियुक्त गरेपछि समन्वय सहज बनेको छ । तर, डा. केसी नियुक्त भएलगत्तै गृहमन्त्री गुरुङ वर्ल्ड पुलिस समिटमा भाग लिन दुबई गएका छन् । प्रहरीको एसपी दर्जासम्मको सरुवा-बढुवाको निर्णय गर्ने अधिकार आईजीपीसँग निहित छ । एसएसपीको गृह सचिवस्तर, डीआईजीको मन्त्रालयस्तर र आईजीपी-एआईजीको सरुवा-बढुवा मन्त्रिपरिषद्को निर्णयबाट हुने गर्दछ । ती विषयका निर्णय लिनुअघि विभागीय मन्त्री र मन्त्रालयसँग समन्वय तथा आवश्यक निर्देशन लिने प्रचलन छ । प्रहरी प्रधान कार्यालयले गत वर्ष भदौ ३१ गते ४८ एसपी र असोज २ गते ९० डीएसपीको सरुवा गरेको थियो । असोज २८ को सरुवामा कार्यक्षेत्र गएका ६५५ जना इन्स्पेक्टर अझै त्यहीँ छन् । सामान्यतया एक वर्षको कार्यअवधि तोकेर प्रहरीको सरुवा हुने गरेको छ । आईजीपी डा. केसीले आफूमा निहित एसपी दर्जासम्मको सरुवा-बढुवाको अधिकार प्रयोग गर्नुअघि सरकारका नीति र निर्देशन पालना गर्नुपर्ने बताए । ‘मन्त्रीज्यू आएपछि छिट्टै हुन्छ’, उनले भने । Kathmandu. Newly appointed IGP of the police, Dr. Manoj Kumar KC, is eager to open the regular transfer and promotion hurdles in the organization. He told Nepal Press that he is waiting for Home Minister Sudhan Gurung, who is currently on a visit to Dubai, to do so. In a meeting with Nepal Press, IGP Dr. KC said that some of the regular work to be done by the organization has been stopped due to various reasons and that these works will be completed soon in coordination with the Home Minister and the ministry. Generally, officers, including the chiefs of various district and area police offices, who are transferred for a one-year term, have been working there for 13-14 months. This has led to other officers, including the chiefs of offices, who are waiting for opportunities for various responsibilities, being turned away from transfers. One AIG post is vacant after the then IGP Dan Bahadur Karki was appointed as the Prime Minister's Security Advisor. 24 DSP posts have been vacant for the past three months. One officer who was appointed as an inspector in 2064, four in 2071, and 19 officers who were appointed as inspectors in 2072 are the candidates for the promotion. The lack of coordination between the police leadership and the government for some time had hampered important tasks such as transfers and promotions. The government appointed the then IGP Karki as a security advisor and Dr. KC as the IGP, and coordination has become easier. However, immediately after Dr. KC was appointed, Home Minister Gurung went to Dubai to participate in the World Police Summit. The IGP has the authority to decide on transfers and promotions of police officers up to the rank of SP. The transfers and promotions of SSPs to the Home Secretary level, DIGs to the ministry level, and IGPs-AIGs are made by the decision of the Council of Ministers. It is customary to coordinate with the departmental ministers and ministries and seek necessary instructions before taking decisions on these matters. The Police Headquarters transferred 48 SPs on Bhadra 31 last year and 90 DSPs on Asoj 2. 655 inspectors who left their work areas in the transfer on Asoj 28 are still there. Generally, police transfers are made after a one-year term. IGP Dr. KC said that government policies and directives should be followed before exercising the right to transfer and promote up to the rank of SP vested in him. "It will happen soon after the minister arrives," he said.

। असोज २८ को सरुवामा कार्यक्षेत्र गएका ६५५ जना इन्स्पेक्टर अझै त्यहीँ छन् । सामान्यतया एक वर्षको कार्यअवधि तोकेर प्रहरीको सरुवा हुने गरेको छ । आईजीपी डा. केसीले आफूमा निहित एसपी दर्जासम्मको सरुवा-बढुवाको अधिकार प्रयोग गर्नुअघि सरकारका नीति र निर्देशन पालना गर्नुपर्ने बताए । ‘मन्त्रीज्यू आएपछि छिट्टै हुन्छ’, उनले भने । Kathmandu. Newly appointed IGP of the police, Dr. Manoj Kumar KC, is eager to open the regular transfer and promotion hurdles in the organization. He told Nepal Press that he is waiting for Home Minister Sudhan Gurung, who is currently on a visit to Dubai, to do so. In a meeting with Nepal Press, IGP Dr. KC said that some of the regular work to be done by the organization has been stopped due to various reasons and that these works will be completed soon in coordination with the Home Minister and the ministry. Generally, officers, including the chiefs of various district and area police offices, who are transferred for a one-year term, have been working there for 13-14 months. This has led to other officers, including the chiefs of offices, who are waiting for opportunities for various responsibilities, being turned away from transfers. One AIG post is vacant after the then IGP Dan Bahadur Karki was appointed as the Prime Minister's Security Advisor. 24 DSP posts have been vacant for the past three months. One officer who was appointed as an inspector in 2064, four in 2071, and 19 officers who were appointed as inspectors in 2072 are the candidates for the promotion. The lack of coordination between the police leadership and the government for some time had hampered important tasks such as transfers and promotions. The government appointed the then IGP Karki as a security advisor and Dr. KC as the IGP, and coordination has become easier. However, immediately after Dr. KC was appointed, Home Minister Gurung went to Dubai to participate in the World Police Summit. The IGP has the authority to decide on transfers and promotions of police officers up to the rank of SP. The transfers and promotions of SSPs to the Home Secretary level, DIGs to the ministry level, and IGPs-AIGs are made by the decision of the Council of Ministers. It is customary to coordinate with the departmental ministers and ministries and seek necessary instructions before taking decisions on these matters. The Police Headquarters transferred 48 SPs on Bhadra 31 last year and 90 DSPs on Asoj 2. 655 inspectors who left their work areas in the transfer on Asoj 28 are still there. Generally, police transfers are made after a one-year term. IGP Dr. KC said that government policies and directives should be followed before exercising the right to transfer and promote up to the rank of SP vested in him. "It will happen soon after the minister arrives," he said.

As transfers of officers who have been working in the police for 13-14 months have been halted, other officers are being deprived of opportunities. काठमाडौं । प्रहरीका नवनियुक्त आईजीपी डा. मनोजकुमार केसी संगठनका नियमित सरुवा-बढुवाको अवरोध (जाम) खोल्न आतुर देखिएका छन् । त्यसका लागि हाल दुबई भ्रमणमा रहेका गृहमन्त्री सुधन गुरुङको प्रतीक्षामा रहेको उनले नेपाल प्रेसलाई बताएका छन् । नेपाल प्रेस सँगको भेटमा आईजीपी डा. केसीले संगठनले गर्नुपर्ने केही नियमित काम विभिन्न कारणले रोकिएको र गृहमन्त्री तथा मन्त्रालयसँग समन्वय गरेर छिट्टै ती काम सम्पन्न गर्ने बताएका हुन् । सामान्यतया एक वर्षको कार्य अवधिका लागि सरुवा भएर विभिन्न जिल्ला र इलाका प्रहरी कार्यालयका प्रमुखसहितका अधिकृत १३-१४ महिनादेखि त्यहीँ कार्यरत छन् । यसले कार्यालय प्रमुखसहित विभिन्न जिम्मेवारीको अवसर पर्खिएका अन्य अधिकृत सरुवाबाट विमुख हुँदै आएका छन् । तत्कालीन आईजीपी दानबहादुर कार्की प्रधानमन्त्रीको सुरक्षा सल्लाहकार नियुक्त भएपछि एक एआईजी पद रिक्त छ । तीन महिनादेखि २४ डीएसपीका दरबन्दी रिक्त छन् । २०६४ मा इन्स्पेक्टर भएका एक, २०७१ का चार र २०७२ मा इन्स्पेक्टर भर्ना भएका १९ अधिकृत उक्त बढुवाका दाबेदार हुन् । प्रहरी नेतृत्व र सरकारबीच केही समयदेखि समन्वय अभाव हुँदा महत्त्वपूर्ण मानिने सरुवा-बढुवाजस्ता काममा बाधा पुगेको थियो । काठमाडौं । प्रहरीका नवनियुक्त आईजीपी डा. मनोजकुमार केसी संगठनका नियमित सरुवा-बढुवाको अवरोध (जाम) खोल्न आतुर देखिएका छन् । त्यसका लागि हाल दुबई भ्रमणमा रहेका गृहमन्त्री सुधन गुरुङको प्रतीक्षामा रहेको उनले नेपाल प्रेसलाई बताएका छन् । नेपाल प्रेस सँगको भेटमा आईजीपी डा. केसीले संगठनले गर्नुपर्ने केही नियमित काम विभिन्न कारणले रोकिएको र गृहमन्त्री तथा मन्त्रालयसँग समन्वय गरेर छिट्टै ती काम सम्पन्न गर्ने बताएका हुन् । सामान्यतया एक वर्षको कार्य अवधिका लागि सरुवा भएर विभिन्न जिल्ला र इलाका प्रहरी कार्यालयका प्रमुखसहितका अधिकृत १३-१४ महिनादेखि त्यहीँ कार्यरत छन् । यसले कार्यालय प्रमुखसहित विभिन्न जिम्मेवारीको अवसर पर्खिएका अन्य अधिकृत सरुवाबाट विमुख हुँदै आएका छन् । तत्कालीन आईजीपी दानबहादुर कार्की प्रधानमन्त्रीको सुरक्षा सल्लाहकार नियुक्त भएपछि एक एआईजी पद रिक्त छ । तीन महिनादेखि २४ डीएसपीका दरबन्दी रिक्त छन् । २०६४ मा इन्स्पेक्टर भएका एक, २०७१ का चार र २०७२ मा इन्स्पेक्टर भर्ना भएका १९ अधिकृत उक्त बढुवाका दाबेदार हुन् । प्रहरी नेतृत्व र सरकारबीच केही समयदेखि समन्वय अभाव हुँदा महत्त्वपूर्ण मानिने सरुवा-बढुवाजस्ता काममा बाधा पुगेको थियो । तत्कालीन आईजीपी कार्कीलाई सरकारले सुरक्षा सल्लाहकार नियुक्त गर्दै डा. केसीलाई आईजीपी नियुक्त गरेपछि समन्वय सहज बनेको छ । तर, डा. केसी नियुक्त भएलगत्तै गृहमन्त्री गुरुङ वर्ल्ड पुलिस समिटमा भाग लिन दुबई गएका छन् । प्रहरीको एसपी दर्जासम्मको सरुवा-बढुवाको निर्णय गर्ने अधिकार आईजीपीसँग निहित छ । एसएसपीको गृह सचिवस्तर, डीआईजीको मन्त्रालयस्तर र आईजीपी-एआईजीको सरुवा-बढुवा मन्त्रिपरिषद्को निर्णयबाट हुने गर्दछ । ती विषयका निर्णय लिनुअघि विभागीय मन्त्री र मन्त्रालयसँग समन्वय तथा आवश्यक निर्देशन लिने प्रचलन छ । प्रहरी प्रधान कार्यालयले गत वर्ष भदौ ३१ गते ४८ एसपी र असोज २ गते ९० डीएसपीको सरुवा गरेको थियो । असोज २८ को सरुवामा कार्यक्षेत्र गएका ६५५ जना इन्स्पेक्टर अझै त्यहीँ छन् । सामान्यतया एक वर्षको कार्यअवधि तोकेर प्रहरीको सरुवा हुने गरेको छ । आईजीपी डा. केसीले आफूमा निहित एसपी दर्जासम्मको सरुवा-बढुवाको अधिकार प्रयोग गर्नुअघि सरकारका नीति र निर्देशन पालना गर्नुपर्ने बताए । ‘मन्त्रीज्यू आएपछि छिट्टै हुन्छ’, उनले भने ।

Kathmandu. Newly appointed IGP of the police, Dr. Manoj Kumar KC, is eager to open the regular transfer and promotion hurdles in the organization. He told Nepal Press that he is waiting for Home Minister Sudhan Gurung, who is currently on a visit to Dubai, to do so. In a meeting with Nepal Press, IGP Dr. KC said that some of the regular work to be done by the organization has been stopped due to various reasons and that these works will be completed soon in coordination with the Home Minister and the ministry. Generally, officers, including the chiefs of various district and area police offices, who are transferred for a one-year term, have been working there for 13-14 months. This has led to other officers, including the chiefs of offices, who are waiting for opportunities for various responsibilities, being turned away from transfers. One AIG post is vacant after the then IGP Dan Bahadur Karki was appointed as the Prime Minister's Security Advisor. 24 DSP posts have been vacant for the past three months. One officer who was appointed as an inspector in 2064, four in 2071, and 19 officers who were appointed as inspectors in 2072 are the candidates for the promotion. The lack of coordination between the police leadership and the government for some time had hampered important tasks such as transfers and promotions. The government appointed the then IGP Karki as a security advisor and Dr. KC as the IGP, and coordination has become easier. However, immediately after Dr. KC was appointed, Home Minister Gurung went to Dubai to participate in the World Police Summit. The IGP has the authority to decide on transfers and promotions of police officers up to the rank of SP. The transfers and promotions of SSPs to the Home Secretary level, DIGs to the ministry level, and IGPs-AIGs are made by the decision of the Council of Ministers. It is customary to coordinate with the departmental ministers and ministries and seek necessary instructions before taking decisions on these matters. The Police Headquarters transferred 48 SPs on Bhadra 31 last year and 90 DSPs on Asoj 2. 655 inspectors who left their work areas in the transfer on Asoj 28 are still there. Generally, police transfers are made after a one-year term. IGP Dr. KC said that government policies and directives should be followed before exercising the right to transfer and promote up to the rank of SP vested in him. "It will happen soon after the minister arrives," he said.
